title: Add basic mypy type checking for vec types

target.summary: `len_callback` checks `len(ctx.arg_types) == 1` without verifying that `ctx.arg_types[0]` is non-empty before accessing `ctx.arg_types[0][0]`. When `len()` is called with zero arguments, this causes an `IndexError` crash.
notes: faulty check that doesn't verify ctx.arg_types[0] is non-empty before indexing
